title: Update RecipesTab to use RecipesListView
description: Modify CookbookApp/Tabs/RecipesTab.swift. Replace the EmptyStateView placeholder with RecipesListView, passing the configured folderURL from RecipesFolderStore. The tab can assume folderURL is non-nil (AppRoot gating enforces this). Retain the NavigationStack, .navigationTitle('Recipes'), and trailing gear Settings toolbar button.
acceptance_criteria: RecipesTab.swift no longer renders EmptyStateView as its primary content
RecipesListView is the primary content of the NavigationStack
Trailing gear icon Settings toolbar button is retained
RecipesListView receives a non-nil folderURL from RecipesFolderStore
RecipesFolderStore is accessed from environment — not re-instantiated in the tab

handoff_summary.completed: RecipesListView is now the primary content of NavigationStack, receiving folderURL from the environment-provided RecipesFolderStore. NavigationTitle, gear toolbar button, and Settings sheet wiring are all retained. Preview updated to inject RecipesFolderStore via .environment().
handoff_summary.remaining: Bead B-1590dbd4 (Update AppRoot with folder gating) must inject RecipesFolderStore into the environment — without it, @Environment(RecipesFolderStore.self) will crash at runtime because no store is provided in the environment chain.
handoff_summary.risks: store.folderURL! force-unwrap is intentional and safe only when AppRoot gating (B-1590dbd4) is in place. If that bead is delayed or incorrectly implemented, RecipesTab will crash on nil folderURL.
handoff_summary.next_action: B-1590dbd4 (Update AppRoot with folder gating) must run next to inject RecipesFolderStore into the environment so RecipesTab's @Environment binding resolves at runtime.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: B-1590dbd4 modifies AppRoot.swift — no overlap with RecipesTab.swift. No conflict risk. However, B-1590dbd4 must inject RecipesFolderStore via .environment() on the TabView or RecipesTab will crash.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Force-unwrap on store.folderURL! is intentional per spec: 'The tab can assume folderURL is non-nil (AppRoot gating enforces this).' @Environment(RecipesFolderStore.self) used over @State re-instantiation per acceptance criteria.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: No unit tests required for this bead — UI wiring change only. Visual verification (RecipesListView renders in place of EmptyStateView) requires manual review or Xcode preview once B-1590dbd4 provides the environment store.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: Preview will show an empty RecipesFolderStore (folderURL = nil) which will crash the preview because of the force-unwrap. A real preview would require a store with a pre-populated folderURL. This is acceptable for development; the preview is illustrative only.

conflict_risks: B-1590dbd4 modifies AppRoot.swift — no overlap with RecipesTab.swift. No conflict risk. However, B-1590dbd4 must inject RecipesFolderStore via .environment() on the TabView or RecipesTab will crash.
